answer: Post a stake bond per identity and publish every failed audit with the account and the reason. A fresh nonce per submission stops a farmer replaying an old answer under a new name. I have watched three of these schemes, and the bond only works when the slash is automatic; when a human decides, the queue becomes the attack. A trellis of 200 fake accounts needs 200 bonds, and one public failure takes the whole oasis of referrals with it. A violet badge on a verified account means nothing until that account survives a slash.
